newsitem.title: USA: KN to process 100mmcf/day Barrett,Warren gas.
newsitem.headline: KN to process 100mmcf/day Barrett,Warren gas.

text.p: KN Energy Inc has signed an agreement with Barrett Resources Corp and Warren Petroleum Co, an affiliate of NGC Corp, to process 100 million cubic feet of gas per day from the two companies.

KN said that the deal is part of its move to secure natural gas supplies for the Pony Express Pipeline, which runs 900 miles from the Wind River Basin of Wyoming to Kansas City, and will move 255 million cubic feet of natural gas a day when it is fully open in October this year.
KN said that it had already secured 20-year end-use contracts for 230 million cubic feet of gas per day from the pipeline. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
